lines: You melt into the sunset
I vanish into the dawn
If we'll never cross paths again
Then that's fate, isn't it
You light a lamp
I stop the light
I'm not afraid — there's nothing left to lose
I never had anything from the start
So then, so then, see you
The boy's eyes are stained
The five o'clock bell rings on, but I can't hear it anymore
So then, so then, it's just as if
It's all over, isn't it
You're dead wrong — the road ahead is long, I won't forget
Ah, let's forget it all and go home
Ah, let it all wash away, and go home
That wound still aches, this thirst still won't heal
But I don't care anymore — let's blow it all away
Let's go home with the fresh breeze
Let's go home with the gently falling rain
What is born at the end of hating each other?
I — I'll be the first to forget
You let your weakness show
I let my lingering attachment spill out
Just this once, let me play God
Because like this, I'm only human
A world without me in it
Even watching it from above
It keeps turning, unchanged, not one thing different
My back feels a little lighter
So then, so then, see you
We part by the highway
Turning my back on the town's endless clamor, I walk on alone
Please, please — that's all I ever said
I never gave you anything, did I
Still without understanding what living has meant
Ah, let's give everything away and go home
Ah, let's carry nothing and go home
What can be given is what was given to us
Let me stand tall and say thank you
I'll be waiting — so let's go home now
Let's go home, to a place where happiness never ends
When it's time to leave, what can you take with you?
One by one, let the baggage go
What is born at the end of hating each other?
I — I'll be the first to forget
Ah, how will I live from today on
